dogecoin.text:
An interesting not well-known fact! 💡

Before @dogecoin, Billy Markus created "Bells," the first-ever meme coin and an exact precursor to Dogecoin. 

Built as a playful experiment, Bells set the stage for Dogecoin’s iconic rise! 🛎️🐕✨ @BellsChain

We explore the story of @dogecoin in a couple of our episodes. 
https://t.co/BqPNUgSrbD

Dogecoin: The Meme That Became a Movement 🚀 @dogecoin 📈 (full episode 👇)

What started as a joke in 2013 turned into one of the most iconic cryptocurrencies ever. 

Dogecoin, featuring the beloved Shiba Inu Kabosu, began as a fun way to engage with crypto and quickly grew into https://t.co/IWvjmaooHV
